title: Google Cloud Digital Leader
short_desc: Foundational Google Cloud certification: digital transformation, data, AI, infrastructure and security.
description: Learn the business and technical foundations of Google Cloud and prepare for the Cloud Digital Leader certification. Video lessons from freeCodeCamp and in28minutes plus the official exam guide.
what_you_learn: Explain how cloud enables digital transformation | Describe Google Cloud data, AI and ML offerings | Compare compute options for modernising infrastructure | Describe Google Cloud security and operations

title: CompTIA Security+
short_desc: Core cybersecurity skills for the CompTIA Security+ certification (SY0-701).
description: Prepare for CompTIA Security+ with a full video course covering threats, architecture, operations and security program management. CompTIA has announced a new version (V8); check the official page for the exam version you will take.
what_you_learn: Identify common threats, attacks and vulnerabilities | Apply security architecture and controls | Understand incident response and security operations | Describe governance, risk and compliance
requirements: Basic networking knowledge is recommended (CompTIA Network+ level)

title: Ethical Hacking (CEH Fundamentals)
short_desc: Learn ethical hacking and penetration testing fundamentals aligned with EC-Council CEH.
description: A practical introduction to ethical hacking: reconnaissance, scanning, exploitation and reporting, with full video courses from The Cyber Mentor and freeCodeCamp. Always practise only on systems you own or have written permission to test.
what_you_learn: Explain the phases of an ethical hack | Perform reconnaissance and scanning in a lab | Understand common web and network exploits | Write a basic penetration test report
requirements: Comfort with Linux command line and networking basics | Only test systems you are authorised to test

title: CISSP Certification Prep
short_desc: Review all eight CISSP domains for the ISC2 Certified Information Systems Security Professional exam.
description: A structured review of the eight CISSP domains with a free full-length video course and the official ISC2 resources. Designed for experienced security professionals preparing for the CISSP.
what_you_learn: Explain security and risk management principles | Protect assets and design secure architectures | Secure networks, identities and software | Run security assessments and operations
requirements: ISC2 requires relevant paid work experience for full certification — see the official page

title: Docker Fundamentals
short_desc: Build, run and ship applications in containers with Docker.
description: Learn containers from scratch: images, containers, Dockerfiles, volumes, networks and Docker Compose. Includes two of the most popular free Docker courses (freeCodeCamp and TechWorld with Nana).
what_you_learn: Explain containers vs virtual machines | Write Dockerfiles and build images | Run multi-container apps with Docker Compose | Persist data with volumes

title: Kubernetes Fundamentals
short_desc: Deploy, scale and manage containerised apps with Kubernetes.
description: Learn Kubernetes architecture and core objects — Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets and Ingress — with two full free courses and the official interactive tutorial.
what_you_learn: Explain the Kubernetes control plane and nodes | Deploy apps with Deployments and Services | Configure apps with ConfigMaps and Secrets | Scale and update workloads safely
requirements: Docker basics (see the Docker Fundamentals course)

title: Jenkins CI/CD
short_desc: Automate builds, tests and deployments with Jenkins pipelines.
description: Set up Jenkins, create freestyle jobs and declarative pipelines, connect to Git and run automated builds and tests. Includes a full 3-hour video course and the official Jenkins tutorials.
what_you_learn: Install and configure Jenkins | Create freestyle jobs and pipelines | Write a Jenkinsfile | Integrate Jenkins with Git and build tools

title: Python Programming for Beginners
short_desc: Learn Python from zero: variables, control flow, functions, data structures and files.
description: A beginner-friendly Python course built around freeCodeCamp's full course and the official Python tutorial.
what_you_learn: Write Python programs with variables and control flow | Use lists, dictionaries, tuples and sets | Create functions and modules | Read and write files and handle errors

title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
short_desc: Understand supervised and unsupervised learning and build your first models in Python.
description: Learn core machine learning ideas — regression, classification, clustering, training vs testing and evaluation — with freeCodeCamp's "Machine Learning for Everybody" and the scikit-learn getting-started guide.
what_you_learn: Explain supervised vs unsupervised learning | Train and evaluate regression and classification models | Avoid overfitting with train/test splits | Use scikit-learn for common ML tasks

title: Power BI for Data Analytics
short_desc: Turn data into interactive reports and dashboards with Microsoft Power BI.
description: Connect to data, clean it with Power Query, model it, write basic DAX and publish interactive reports. Video course from Pragmatic Works plus Microsoft Learn documentation.
what_you_learn: Import and transform data with Power Query | Build a data model with relationships | Write basic DAX measures | Design and publish interactive reports

title: Agile & Scrum Fundamentals
short_desc: Learn Agile values and the Scrum framework: roles, events and artifacts.
description: Understand the Agile Manifesto and the Scrum framework as defined in the Scrum Guide. Video courses walk through the guide and real-world practice — a good foundation for PSM/CSM certifications.
what_you_learn: Explain Agile values and principles | Describe Scrum accountabilities, events and artifacts | Run Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Review and Retrospective | Manage a Product Backlog

title: PRINCE2 Foundation (7th Edition)
short_desc: Learn the PRINCE2 7th edition principles, practices and processes for the Foundation exam.
description: A walkthrough of PRINCE2 — principles, practices and processes — with free video lessons and the official AXELOS/PeopleCert resources.
what_you_learn: Explain the 7 PRINCE2 principles | Describe the 7 practices and 7 processes | Tailor PRINCE2 to a project | Prepare for the PRINCE2 Foundation exam

title: Cisco CCNA (200-301)
short_desc: Networking fundamentals, IP routing, switching, security and automation for Cisco CCNA 200-301.
description: Prepare for Cisco CCNA 200-301 with Jeremy's IT Lab free CCNA series (start with Day 1 here and continue on the channel) and the official Cisco exam page.
what_you_learn: Explain network devices and the OSI/TCP-IP models | Configure VLANs, switching and IP routing | Subnet IPv4 networks and understand IPv6 | Describe network security and automation basics
requirements: Basic computer knowledge; a lab simulator such as Cisco Packet Tracer is recommended

title: CompTIA Network+
short_desc: Vendor-neutral networking skills for CompTIA Network+ (N10-009).
description: Learn networking concepts, implementation, operations, security and troubleshooting for CompTIA Network+ with a complete free video course.
what_you_learn: Explain the OSI model, ports and protocols | Plan IP addressing and subnets | Configure and secure network devices | Troubleshoot common network problems
requirements: Basic IT knowledge (CompTIA A+ level helps)

title: ITIL 4 Foundation
short_desc: IT service management with ITIL 4: service value system, guiding principles and practices.
description: Learn the ITIL 4 framework — key concepts, the service value system, the four dimensions, guiding principles and core practices — and prepare for the ITIL 4 Foundation exam.
what_you_learn: Explain key ITSM concepts such as value, outcomes, costs and risks | Describe the service value system and value chain | Apply the 7 guiding principles | Describe key ITIL practices such as incident and change

title: ServiceNow Administration Fundamentals
short_desc: Learn the ServiceNow platform as an administrator: navigation, ITSM, forms, lists, users and roles.
description: Get started with ServiceNow administration — the user interface, tables, forms and lists, users/groups/roles, incident and change, and basic configuration — with a free video course and the ServiceNow developer site for a free personal instance.
what_you_learn: Navigate the ServiceNow platform | Configure forms, lists and fields | Manage users, groups and roles | Work with ITSM processes such as Incident and Change
requirements: Basic IT/ITSM knowledge (see the ITIL 4 course)

title: JavaScript Fundamentals
short_desc: Learn modern JavaScript: variables, functions, arrays, objects, DOM and async code.
description: A complete beginner path through JavaScript with two freeCodeCamp courses and the MDN JavaScript Guide.
what_you_learn: Use variables, types and operators | Write functions, loops and conditionals | Work with arrays and objects | Understand the DOM, events and asynchronous code

title: React.js Fundamentals
short_desc: Build modern user interfaces with React: components, props, state, hooks and routing.
description: Learn React by building projects with two popular freeCodeCamp courses and the official react.dev Learn guide.
what_you_learn: Build reusable components with JSX | Manage state and props | Use hooks such as useState and useEffect | Fetch data and handle events
requirements: JavaScript fundamentals (see the JavaScript course) | Basic HTML and CSS

title: System Design Fundamentals
short_desc: Design scalable systems: load balancing, caching, databases, queues and trade-offs.
description: Learn how large-scale systems are designed — scalability, availability, caching, databases, messaging and API design — with freeCodeCamp's System Design for Beginners course and the open-source System Design Primer.
what_you_learn: Explain vertical vs horizontal scaling | Use load balancers, caches and CDNs | Choose between SQL and NoSQL databases | Reason about consistency, availability and trade-offs
requirements: Programming experience | Basic networking and database knowledge
